coverage_definition.state_aid: A state counts as complete only when the current official state-aid catalog relevant to the product is normalized and source-verified.
coverage_definition.institution: An institution counts as verified when identity plus at least one current policy domain is persisted and source-verified.
coverage_definition.complete_institution: Costs, admissions, merit, credit/transfer and appeal policy domains are all current or explicitly not applicable.

current_batches.notes: HOPE, Aspire, GAMS, Tennessee Promise, and Wilder-Naifeh are persisted. Remaining Tennessee programs still need normalization before state coverage is marked complete.

Institution identity, AP/CLEP policy seed, selected AP equivalencies, one current institutional award, and appeal/negotiation-gate policy are persisted. Costs, admissions metrics, transfer rules, full scholarship catalog, and full prior-learning tables remain.

notes: Counts include only records persisted in this repository.
Prior conversational research is not counted until it is written to the repository and source-verified.
Negative policy findings are treated conservatively; absence of a published offer-negotiation path is not upgraded to a verified negative without sufficient official-source review.
